page: Microsoft Azure E64-32s_v6 is a memory-optimized server configuration based on the Intel Xeon 8573C processor running on Microsoft Hyper-V. Operating on the x86_64 architecture at 4.2 GHz, the instance delivers 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 16 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. Cache capacity includes 48 KB of L1 data cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and a large 260 MB L3 cache. System memory totals 512.0 GB, creating a constrained-core memory ratio of 16 GB per core. Hardware execution is augmented by specialized instruction extensions, including AVX-512, AMX-Tile, and AMX-INT8 matrix acceleration.

Benchmark measurements demonstrate strong performance across uncached memory throughput and multi-threaded integer tasks. In large-block memory evaluation, the platform achieved 246.92 GB/sec read throughput and 141.39 GB/sec write throughput, placing it in the upper quartile for memory subsystems. Geekbench assessments recorded single-core scores of 2143.0 and multi-core scores of 17375.0, accompanied by strong throughput in image and text processing. Static web serving throughput reached 44.87 GB/sec, while synthetic PassMark physics testing demonstrated high computational execution. Average performance tiers were observed in stress-ng evaluations, PassMark database calculations, and Redis operations, the latter attaining 43.96 million operations per second.

The E64-32s_v6 contains no integrated local storage and includes zero dedicated GPUs, requiring network-attached storage infrastructure for all persistent file systems. By providing 512 GB of memory across a reduced 32-vCPU envelope derived from a 64-vCPU chassis, the configuration delivers qualitative cost efficiency for software licensed on a per-core basis that requires massive RAM footprints. This configuration avoids excess vCPU expenditure while delivering high memory density. The server profile is suited for memory-bound workloads, including large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise caching layers, big data analytics engines, and high-throughput web serving.
description: Microsoft Azure E64-32s_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by a 4.2 GHz Intel Xeon 8573C processor using the x86_64 architecture. Configured with 32 dedicated vCPUs across 16 physical cores and 512 GB of memory, it provides a dense 16 GB per core allocation. The hardware platform integrates advanced instruction sets including AVX-512, AMX-INT8, and AMX-Tile, alongside a large 260 MB L3 cache. Benchmark testing shows strong uncached memory bandwidth, reaching 246.92 GB/sec for reads and 141.39 GB/sec for writes, alongside strong Geekbench multi-core results. The server includes no bundled local disk storage and lacks discrete GPUs, meaning all persistent storage operations require external network-attached volumes. This architecture provides high memory density relative to core count, making it cost-efficient for memory-constrained workloads without requiring payment for unneeded compute capacity. The instance is suited for in-memory databases, large Redis deployments, analytical processing, and enterprise data warehousing.
